answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 41218 Country: India Title: Is Ghulam Ahmed Qadiyani was the teacher of Ahmed Raza Khan or his brother was the teacher of Ahmed Raza Khan Barailavi? Please give the answer with reference. Question: Is Ghulam Ahmed Qadiyani was the teacher of Ahmed Raza Khan or his brother was the teacher of Ahmed Raza Khan Barailavi? Please give the answer with reference. Answer ID: 41218 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 861/867/N=1433) Yes, it is correct that Ahmad Raza Khan was the disciple of Ghulam Qadir the brother of Ghulam Ahmad Qadiyani (Mutala Barailaviat 2:49, with reference to Malfuzat Vol. 2, p. 28) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
